verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands Q waveclear-trades and Deathbringer Stance autos freely before level 6; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and out-scale his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) threatens three successive sword slams and his passive Deathbringer Stance punishes free autos with a healing nuke, so he wins extended trades and all-ins before Jax has items. Jax's win condition is baiting out Q and the empowered auto, then answering with E (Counter Strike) and Trinity Force spikes once levels and gold close the gap.

theirWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance is up and Q is ready
theirWindow.what: He will walk up for a free empowered auto then chain into Q slams for a big trade. Do not stand still in melee range when his passive is glowing and Q is off cooldown.

yourWindow.when: He just used Q or E (Umbral Dash) to engage
yourWindow.what: Jax's Q (14-11-8-5s cooldown as he levels) lets him leap in right as Aatrox's own mobility and main damage tool are down. Punish with W (Empower) on the leap and follow with E (Counter Strike) since he has no dash to escape the stun.

start.why: The 65.3% pick rate option; the extra damage and sustain help you survive Q trades without falling behind on health.

boots.why: The 70.2%-picked boots; the flat damage reduction blunts repeated auto and Q-slam poke from Aatrox.

core.why: The highest-picked first core item (58.6-65.6% win rate across those paths); the stat stick and proc damage are what let Jax start winning trades.
Second item in all three measured core paths; adds survivability and burst to Counter Strike engages.
Paired with Trinity Force at a 65.6% win rate over 125 games; the damage mitigation directly counters Aatrox's burst windows.

situational.when: he is building toward all-in kill pressure and you need to survive a Q plus Deathbringer Stance burst
he stacks health or you need sustained DPS instead of burst
his team adds hard CC on top of his E (Umbral Dash) engage

runes.keystoneWhy: The 52.6%-win-rate page; the sustain from Grasp directly offsets Aatrox's passive healing and three-hit Q poke over a long lane.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo at 81.8% pick rate and 49.2% win rate; Ignite punishes his Deathbringer Stance healing and secures kills once you land Counter Strike.

playing.title: Never stand in melee when passive glows
playing.detail: If Deathbringer Stance is up and Q is ready, back off minion range. Walking into that combo is how you lose the trade outright.

playing.title: Hold E for his engage, not yours
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all basic attacks and stuns after its channel. Save it to answer his E (Umbral Dash) dash-in rather than opening with it.

playing.title: Leap in when his dash is down
playing.detail: Q (Leap Strike) on 17-5s cooldown as you level lets you punish the moment his Umbral Dash (9-5s cooldown) is spent and he has no escape.

playing.title: Short-trade, don't stand in Q swings
playing.detail: His Q can swing three separate times. Hit-and-leave trades beat planting your feet and absorbing all three slams.

playing.title: Track his ultimate at 120-80s cooldown
playing.detail: World Ender gives him attack damage, healing, and move speed with extended duration on a takedown. Do not extend fights once he has flipped into it.

playing.title: Buy into the grievous wounds plan
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this lane is to itemize against his healing. Death's Dance and Ignite both cut into Deathbringer Stance and World Ender sustain.

playing.title: Scale through, don't force level 1-5 fights
playing.detail: The data shows Aatrox has both lane and solo-kill advantage early. Farm safely under turret pressure until Trinity Force comes online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Aatrox’s The Darkin Blade (Q)! Use Counter Strike [E] to block his Deathbringer Stance (P). Purchase items that reduce healing.
